title: A power multiple of every formal glueing chart section lifts to H^0
statement: Let $R,S$ be commutative rings, $\varphi:R\to S$ flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], $f:\{1,\ldots,t\}\to R$, and $X$ a formal glueing datum [def-weil-pbc-formal-glueing-data]. Let $H^0(X)$ be its compatible-section submodule [def-weil-pbc-formal-glueing-H0], and $M_i$ its $R_{f_i}$-module chart [def-weil-ring-localization-away]. For each index $i$ and $x\in M_i$, there exist $n\geq0$ and $h\in H^0(X)$ such that the $i$-th chart coordinate of $h$ equals $f_i^n x$.

source.place: Remark 05EL; Lemmas 05EQ and 05EP, used in Proposition 05ER, second paragraph (verified at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/05ER and the linked tags 05EL, 05EQ, 05EP).

proof.text: Form the explicit canonical localized tuple with prime coordinate alpha_i inverse of 1 tensor x and chart coordinates alpha_ij(x/1). Its prime/chart and chart/chart differences vanish by [lem-weil-pbc-formal-glueing-localized-chart-tuple].

The all-equal cocycle makes the localized self-overlap idempotent. Localization preserves injectivity, so cancel it; multiplication by every localization denominator is injective in a localized module. Thus alpha_ii is the identity. The finite-product comparison and uniqueness on numerators identify the i coordinate of the canonical tuple with x/1.

Take a numerator m and denominator s of the canonical tuple using IsLocalizedModule.surj. Apply each localized compatibility difference to s*z=mk(m,1): every difference of m localizes to zero. Apply IsLocalizedModule.exists_of_eq to the finite product of prime/chart differences and to the finite product indexed by pairs of chart indices; obtain powers r and q killing the respective families. Then y=q*r*m satisfies both families, hence belongs to h0. Its localized i coordinate equals q*r*s*x. The chart is already a module over R[1/f_i], so its self-localization is linearly equivalent to itself. Apply this equivalence to obtain the equality in the original chart. Write q*r*s=f_i^n and take h=(y,hy).

proof_origin.place: Remark 05EL; Lemmas 05EQ and 05EP used in Proposition 05ER. Lean proves self-overlap identity, finite denominator/error clearing and injectivity; only compatibility of the explicitly specified localized tuple is split off.

theorem h0_chart_power_lift {t : ℕ} (φ : R →+* S) (hflat : φ.Flat)
    (f : Fin t → R) (X : Data.{u, v, w} φ f) (i : Fin t)
    (x : piece (f i) (X.M i)) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (h : h0 φ f X), h.val.2 i = (f i) ^ n • x
